result:
Authors can now edit their own comments, but none of it has been run, tested or linted, as you asked.

- **API:** `api/update-comment.ts` is new. It sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`, validated with Zod, and refreshes the comments list on success. The "Comment Updated" success notification is also in this hook. `features/CLAUDE.md` says notifications belong there, not in components. The existing create, delete and update-discussion components still show theirs in the component, and I left those alone.
- **UI:** `components/update-comment.tsx` is new. It adds an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer pre-filled with the current body. `comments-list.tsx` shows it only when `comment.author?.id` matches the current user. Admins still see Delete on every comment but not Edit.
- **Mock API:** `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` has a new PATCH handler. It only updates a comment whose author is the current user and returns 404 otherwise.
